governingContracts.manifest: SloAnalytica MachineData UX Construction Manifest v7.1

program.strategy: machine-by-machine v7.1 reconstruction using existing artifacts; targeted external re-research only when current contracts cannot be established
program.baseDriftNote: Current integration HEAD is a report timestamp-only refresh after the last known semantic merge; no semantic source drift observed in that commit.

activeWork.purpose: Make user-burden reduction and timeout-safe restartability normative before reconstruction pilot.

knownFleetBaseline.note: Post-Batch2 full-fleet reconstruction strategy metrics must be recomputed before using counts as current completion facts.

userBurden.countingRule: Initial user authorization to proceed and final completion report are excluded from UIC.

nextAction.instruction: After this continuity-contract change is reviewed and integrated, run a no-production-mutation reconstruction strategy/pilot-preparation audit from current prototype-multi-machine. Measure machine-level gate deficits and select a representative pilot cohort. Do not begin broad production reconstruction until the pilot establishes actual intervention rate and work units.

stopConditions: A product/application semantic change requires approval.
An existing Selection decision would be overturned.
Required meaning cannot be resolved from repository evidence or authoritative research.
Real-device-only verification is required for the affected item; defer that item and continue independent work.
A proposed action would touch public main during audit/reconstruction.
A validator/proof contract would need to be weakened or runtime semantics changed merely to pass audit.
